withheld_reason.contributions: The retained document has NO Schedule A page at all. `pdfinfo` reports Pages: 3, and each page was read full-page and classified from its own printed heading: p1 the 2014 cover ('2014 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES', Utah County Code 2-5), p2 'SUMMARY PAGE', p3 'SCHEDULE B / ITEMIZED EXPENDITURES MADE'. There is no fourth page and no Schedule A anywhere in the file. This is non-existence of the page, not a blank page and not an unread one — and it is consistent with the cover, whose line 1 Column A contributions cell is a handwritten oval ZERO.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' expenditures, line 2 TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE = 1,002.90 on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE — the same figure printed again at summary line 6 ('From Line 2 Column A'), at Schedule B's own 'Subtotal for this page' $1002.90, and at its 'Total Expenditures Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule B pages)' $1002.90
expenditures.detail: 9 Schedule B rows sum to 109.93 + 63.82 + 342.77 + 219.91 + 21.34 + 102.48 + 60.85 + 63.86 + 17.94 = 1,002.90 exactly. That equals the schedule's printed page subtotal (1002.90), its printed Total Expenditures Received (1002.90), the cover's PROMOTED per-period cell (line 2 Column A = 1002.90) and summary line 6 (1002.90). FOUR printed anchors agree to the cent. Column B (Year-to-Date Total) is LEFT WHOLLY BLANK by this filer on both lines — there is no cumulative figure on this document to sum or to difference, and none was synthesized. The balance ladder also closes: line 3 beginning 0 + line 4 contributions 0 = line 5 subtotal 0, minus line 6 1002.90 = line 7 -1002.90, printed with the minus sign.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only closed exactly (1,002.90). Tested both: neither schedule on this form prints an in-kind column, no row on Schedule B is marked in-kind, and the cover prints no separate in-kind line, so the monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind conventions are numerically identical here and both close on the same figure.
itemized.escalation_note: Three 900 dpi tight-cell crops, all for GEOMETRY PROOF rather than to settle a figure: the row-1 amount box, the row-9 amount box and the row-10 (one-past-the-end) control band. A fourth 700 dpi strip crop of the Date + Name columns confirmed the two ditto marks and the vendor spellings. No amount was in doubt; nothing was re-read to change a value.

On the summary page, line 1 (contributions this period), line 3 (balance at beginning), line 4 and line 5 are all handwritten OVAL ZEROS and read 0 under the repo-wide zero-glyph ruling (the cover tranche read them the same way); they are numerals, not nil marks — this filer writes an unmistakable closed oval, and writes '-1002.90' with an explicit minus at line 7.
